timeline.label: First karts
timeline.text: Discovered karting during the pandemic period and moved from casual driving toward competition.

timeline.label: First full development season
timeline.text: Third in the Zealand Championship; strong Danish/Nordic IAME results reported by Vogue Scandinavia.

timeline.label: Breakthrough
timeline.text: Won the Zealand Championship and won the Senior category of FIA Girls on Track - Rising Stars.

timeline.label: Single-seaters
timeline.text: Made Indian F4 debut; MP Motorsport profile records a best result of sixth.

timeline.label: F1 Academy rookie
timeline.text: Seventh overall with seven top-five finishes while representing Tommy Hilfiger; also gained British F4 experience.

timeline.label: Beyond the cockpit
timeline.text: Vogue/Teen Vogue editorial visibility, G.I.R.L. growth, book tour, and FIA Women in Motorsport Award.

timeline.label: Ferrari
timeline.text: Joined the Scuderia Ferrari Driver Academy; second F1 Academy season with MP Motorsport in Ferrari colours; British F4 development programme; WHOOP global ambassador.

timeline.label: Open
timeline.text: Do not invent a destination. Leave the timeline visually open-ended.
